title: Hierarchical models and learning to learn
summary: Overhypotheses and shared priors; the blessing of abstraction; the shape bias and one-shot learning of categories; intuitive theories and the role of theories in induction; learning domain structures.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is OCW lectures 19–21 (Intuitive Biology and the Role of Theories; Learning Domain Structures 1–2), lecture 11's hierarchical-priors slides, and the web book's Hierarchical models chapter.

preparation.description: Revisit OCW lecture 11 slides 30–39 (origin of prior knowledge; problems with simple empiricism; a simple theory; hierarchical priors) and read lectures 19, 20 and 21.
Read the web book's Hierarchical models chapter (shared prototypes; the blessing of abstraction; overhypotheses; the shape bias; one-shot learning of visual categories). Reference-only.
